title: Call / WhatsApp / SMS quick-contact buttons on tenant profile
description: Add three quick-action buttons on the tenant profile screen: Call, WhatsApp, SMS. Each redirects the warden to the respective app pre-filled with the tenant's phone number, then stops - no call is placed, no message is sent, automatically. This is a general contact shortcut for reaching a tenant any time, distinct from the payment-reminder buttons in LODGY-18/LODGY-19 which are tied to a specific unpaid invoice and pre-fill a payment-due message. Implementation: Call uses ACTION_DIAL (not ACTION_CALL, which would dial immediately and require the CALL_PHONE permission), WhatsApp uses a wa.me deep link, SMS uses an smsto: intent - same tap-to-send/tap-to-dial principle as the rest of the app, no new permissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant profile screen shows Call, WhatsApp, and SMS buttons
Call button opens the device dialer pre-filled with the tenant's number via ACTION_DIAL - does not place the call automatically
WhatsApp button opens a chat with the tenant's number via a wa.me deep link - does not send any message automatically
SMS button opens the default messaging app's compose screen pre-filled with the tenant's number - does not send automatically
No CALL_PHONE or SEND_SMS permission is requested
If WhatsApp is not installed on the device, the WhatsApp button fails gracefully (e.g. disabled state or a clear message) instead of crashing
Buttons remain accessible on a vacated tenant's profile too, not just active tenants

history.note: Added per explicit user request: general Call/WhatsApp/SMS quick-contact on tenant profile, tap-to-open only, nothing auto-sent/auto-dialed. Deliberately kept separate from LODGY-18/LODGY-19 (invoice-specific payment reminders) rather than merged, since scope and pre-filled content differ.
